title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When you decrease the bias of a model, it often means the model is fitting the training data more closely. Think about what happens to the model's flexibility and how it might affect its performance on new data.

title: Tradeoff Between Bias and Variance
text: Consider the bias-variance tradeoff. Reducing bias might lead to an increase in variance. What does this mean for the model's predictions on unseen data?

title: Impact on Variance
text: If the model's bias decreases, what is likely to happen to the variance?
